description: Rules in input (X) space, purity measured against the network output (model predictions). band_lo/band_hi are bias-absorbed: check band_lo <= w*x <= band_hi. null=unbounded. Fixed-k=7 sparsification (keep-all): each condition uses only its top-k weights, recorded in 'sparse_weights'. Fallback mode: small_nn.
